Oneliner

Participating in the CubeSat Portugal competition.
Description

The primary mission requires the satellite to do the minimum requirements expected for the satellite’s successful deployment. These requirements consider the assembly process, launch and deployment of the Engineering Model/Pre-Flight Model; Meanwhile, the Secondary Mission allows each team to showcase their legacy, offering an opportunity to think creatively about their contributions to the program.

Our team is made up of 23 students from various universities, such as Técnico Lisboa, ISCTE, ISEL, FCUL and ISEG and 1 professor from Técnico Lisboa, organized into seven distinct departments: Structures and Thermal Systems, Attitude Determination and Control System, Command and Data Handling, Payload, Power Systems, Communications Systems and Operations & Marketing.
